question: If ΔBPQ ≅ ΔASR and ∠A = {{1} over 3}∠R = ∠S then find ∠Q. (All angles are in degrees).
solution:
**Given:**

∠A = {{1} over 3}∠R = ∠S

**Concept used:**

If two triangles are congruent, then their corresponding angles are equal

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c4db0dff6d31627a9102b20e31fbd03a6f634ac0357cebe7b5fad65a76c6df3.png] 

∠A = {{1} over 3}∠R

⇒ 3∠A = ∠R

Again,

{{1} over 3}∠R = ∠S

⇒ ∠R = 3∠S

Also ∠A = ∠S

Now,

∠A + ∠R + ∠S = 180°

⇒ ∠A + 3∠A + ∠A = 180°

⇒ 5∠A = 180°

⇒ ∠A = 36°

So, ∠R = 3 × 36°

⇒ 108°

Now,

As ΔBPQ ≅ ΔASR

So, ∠R = ∠Q

So, ∠Q = 108°

**∴ The required answer is 108°.**
